sources.title: GF180MCU 4.0 Resistor Models
sources.locator: 4.1 Model Features; 4.3 Model Syntax for Resistors
sources.supports: The public resistor model is an RC subcircuit with body/end temperature coefficients and resistor-to-substrate capacitance. A constant ideal resistance is not the same model.
sources.limit: Actual numeric coefficients and source identity must come from the pinned local model used by each run. Live documentation is not a replacement for the lock.

sources.title: GF180MCU 1.4.4 Resistors
sources.supports: Public three-terminal high-sheet-resistance P-type poly resistor model, with scalable geometry and corner modeling.
sources.limit: This list does not establish production qualification of this project.

sources.title: GF180MCU 1.0 Low Voltage Devices (3.3V)
sources.supports: 3.63 V appears as an off-current characterization condition at 25 C in the public electrical table.
sources.limit: It does not establish an all-terminal transient reliability limit. This project retains 3.63 V as its own screening threshold, not foundry signoff.
